description: CAMBER Real-Time Road Infrastructure Condition Dataset API is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors ICCS. This record provides access to a live API for the CAMBER (Connected and Adaptive Maintenance for Safer Urban and Secondary Roads) road infrastructure condition dataset. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
